objective: Extend CIRA-001 with governed staged entry, staged exit, adaptive position scaling and staged rotation/rebalance semantics before P15/P16/P20/P21 implementation begins, without authorizing P12, Live Trading or Auto Trading.
scope: Define Staged Entry / Scale-In semantics with a pre-declared maximum position and risk ceiling
Define Staged Exit / Scale-Out semantics including partial profit-taking, de-risking, emergency reduction and trailing remainder
Define Adaptive Position Scaling where tranche size/spacing can depend on validated signal strength, volatility, liquidity, regime, portfolio risk and execution cost
Require fresh signal/thesis/regime/data/liquidity/risk validation before every tranche that adds risk
Cancel all unfilled entry tranches when invalidation is breached or risk/firewall state fails
Forbid adding size merely because price moved against the position
Forbid Martingale, uncapped averaging down and loss-chasing position escalation
Allow pyramiding only when the thesis remains valid or strengthens and total portfolio risk remains within P15 ceilings
Define staged CARE rotation/rebalance semantics so cross-asset moves may be executed progressively rather than all-at-once
Define P15 ownership of max position, total risk budget and tranche plan; P16 independent approval of each new-risk tranche; P20 idempotent execution; P21 partial-close/reduction lifecycle
Require P17 backtest/OOS/walk-forward/stress evaluation and P18/P19 Demo-Shadow validation of staged policies
Require P23 UX to show total intended exposure, filled exposure, remaining tranches, cancellation reasons and risk state
out_of_scope: Implementing runtime P15, P16, P20 or P21 code in this governance task
Hard-coding a universal tranche count, fixed percentages or fixed spacing before empirical calibration
Martingale, unlimited averaging down or doubling after losses
Live Trading, Auto Trading, broker credentials, funding or orders
dependencies: Owner authorization in project conversation on 2026-10-11
No active task or lock at task start
tests: Every tranche that adds risk requires fresh P15/P16 eligibility
Price moving against a position alone cannot authorize added size
Martingale and uncapped averaging-down behavior are explicitly forbidden
Invalidation breach cancels remaining entry tranches
Total planned plus filled exposure cannot exceed pre-approved P15 position/risk ceilings
P20 staged execution is required to be idempotent and recoverable from partial fills
P21 supports partial reduction/close without forcing full position exit
Tranche count/spacing/size remain TO_BE_CALIBRATED by governed empirical evidence
Live Trading and Auto Trading remain DISABLED
security_tests: No broker/exchange credentials or order authority introduced
A5 Risk and P16 Pre-Trade Firewall retain independent veto
No tranche can bypass system health or data-quality fail-closed states
No LLM/agent judgment can directly increase exposure
evidence: Updated CIRA-001 addendum with staged scaling policy
Git SHA and PR Governance result
rollback: Revert FIN-P00-WY-001 contract and CIRA-001 staged-scaling extension changes. CIRA-001 base capabilities, frozen Master Roadmap, P08-P11 closures, P12 authorization boundary and trading states remain unchanged.

Martingale and price-only averaging down are explicitly prohibited
Per-tranche revalidation and cancellation behavior are explicit
